prepare.credential_reads: Effective explicitly supplied environment and existing read_config/require_keys semantics; key presence only is projected. No account status or authentication request is made.
prepare.commands: Bounded existing Node --version, Claude --version/--help, and Cargo --version only. Command environments omit credential values. Executable aliases retain their intended argv0, including Cargo's rustup shim.
prepare.identities: All111 frozen Node files; full allowlisted native source manifest; fixed protocol, live v2 fixtures, Rust repair source/test/manifest, original live rubric; Node/helper/Claude/Cargo executable hashes and versions; exact safe routing/model/evaluator configuration. Source commit is operator declared and requires independent evidence for approval.
prepare.privacy: No credential value or credential fingerprint, custom header value, raw stdout diagnostic or raw stderr content is persisted. Private metadata and original sanitized JSON reports are create-only. Known inherited credential values are checked in memory against admitted report strings/keys; unknown extension fields are rejected. This does not claim discovery of arbitrary unrelated secrets.
prepare.creation: New0700 directory,0600 evidence,0700 Node/native executable copies; bounded no-follow regular input reads. Existing Claude/Cargo installations are observed and left unchanged.

run.engine_commands: The same native xtask live-validation command for native and node-reference gateway engines; no provider request wrapper or permission workaround.
run.client_models: Exact configured Haiku for compatible and Sonnet for Auto.
run.order: Odd pairs node-reference then native; even pairs native then node-reference; every child joins before the next admission.
run.case_selector: Omit --case. The existing default full-profile set is exactly simple, medium, difficult, coding, continuation, thinking_continuation. Explicit selectors currently use expectedTier and can lose required tier coverage for v2 expectedClassifiedTier scenarios; that separate bug remains unfixed and cannot qualify this protocol.
run.provider_call_budget: Not120: continuation prompts, tool execution, independent verifier and auxiliary provider requests add work. No fixed API-call or cost budget is claimed.
run.source_and_configuration_drift: Before/after every engine, reject source/reference/fixture/protocol/rubric/client/helper/safe configuration drift. Authentication identity cannot be safely fingerprinted; unchanged account/authentication settings are an explicit operator condition, not a measured fact.
run.conditions: Normal-use apps may remain open; builds/tests paused during live calls. Record available power/load/RAM/compression/swap before and after each engine separately from operator declarations.
run.failures: No retry, sample relabeling, provider fallback wrapper or in-place evidence repair. Preserve exit1 original quality reports and continue all declared pairs. Missing/invalid/private/bounded/worker-failed reports stop further child admission and cannot qualify; cancellation and drift also stop admission. Keep create-only interrupted output.

cleanup.outer: OwnedChild/ExitObserver keeps the outer helper leader unreaped until owned-group termination and joins the worker before returning.
cleanup.normal_observations: Tool-only live metadata records actual awaited gateway close, native router.inner.close completion, bounded after-close connection-refused observation and existing owned fixture removal. Node close retains actual closed/protocol/process results. Native GatewayHandle.close suppresses JoinError, so worker join outcome remains explicitly unavailable.
cleanup.abnormal_limitation: Existing nested Claude/reference commands create their own groups. An outer SIGKILL cannot independently prove their termination or reap arbitrary escaped descendants/daemons. Every abnormal/missing report keeps nested cleanup unverified and fails/incompletes comparison; observed normal cleanup is the strongest claim.

gates.original: Recompute original evaluate_live_case/evaluate_live_report acceptance, retain every absolute quality failure. Require all original mandatory fields/types, closed nested shapes, public-evidence check consistency and actual six fresh case-progress rows matching the complete final report in the existing default order. Synthetic task indices are exact immutable-prompt matches in both tool adapters, outside actual decisions/telemetry/provider bytes; bind every expected label to the frozen index. Repeated indices are legitimate retries; absent/unknown indices retain original quality failure, and missing declared task mappings cannot qualify the complete fixture comparison.
gates.tier_coverage: Exact default nonempty required tiers Haiku/Sonnet/Opus for compatible or Sonnet/Opus for Auto. No vacuous coverage accepted.
gates.relative: Every pair retains the unchanged protocol-v2 maxima0 for native-only transport/protocol/observed-cleanup, permission/private-fixture and independent coding failures, and minima0 for native-minus-baseline task, rubric and tier rates. Exact integer counts and fixed denominators avoid rounding; no positive pooled result hides a failed pair.
gates.private_state_observation_scope: Existing isolated Claude arguments and original synthetic test/manifest preservation checks; arbitrary account-store writes are not inspected or fingerprinted.
gates.descriptive: Original provider/cache/evaluator-call/route/latency evidence stays separate; stochastic responses and token counts are not required identical or reinterpreted as transport equality. Five pairs are finite live observations, not general model quality equivalence.

separate_approval: No controlled hardware, numerical gateway performance, shipping source-to-binary provenance, full platform/release/cutover or deferred larger-Mac local-model qualification is implied.
